headline.head: $299 WHEN THE NEXT BID WAS $5
headline.sub: BDALOHA went $294 clear of the field for Tony Pollard. Only the winner pays, and the winner paid.

paper.obituary: Lowest score. No appeal. No mercy.

jokes.premise: a fight nobody else was having
jokes.text: BDALOHA went $294 clear of a fight nobody else was having.

jokes.premise: bidding against nobody and still overpaying
jokes.text: That's not an auction, that's bidding against nobody and still overpaying.
Then BDALOHA benched him. Pollard scored 13.6 points, none of which were witnessed.
Nobody made BDALOHA do this. BDALOHA did this to BDALOHA.

jokes.premise: corroborated the zero by never starting him
jokes.text: Returned 0.0 points, a number maruniak independently corroborated by never starting him.
That's $520 a point, for anyone doing the math they shouldn't be doing.

jokes.premise: a losing bid costs nothing, which is what it was worth
jokes.text: A losing bid costs nothing, which is convenient, because that's exactly what this one was worth.

jokes.premise: the steal sat on the bench too
jokes.text: The one defensible transaction of the week, undercut slightly by never making the lineup either.

jokes.premise: runners-up kept their money and dignity
jokes.text: The runners-up kept their money and their dignity, which is more than can be said for BDALOHA.

_note: Rebuilt from the emails as sent (league-memory/archive). Lines the commissioner corrected are left out.
